payload.fact: Has Knight Therapeutics (Barbados) Inc. given written consent, or a waiver of the clause "Synergy shall not add any other debt without paying out KTI first", for a new $100,000–$250,000 fixed-installment working-capital advance? If so, on what terms (e.g., permitted basket, subordination, lien carve-out)?
payload.why_pivotal: Without consent, any new advance breaches Knight's senior secured covenant. A breach can put the ~$12.3M Knight loan into default (plus 5% default interest) and cross-default the ~$9.8M Sanders loan. That would dwarf any benefit of the advance, whichever offer is chosen.
payload.acceptable_evidence: Signed consent or waiver letter from Knight, or the executed Sixth Amendment text showing a permitted-indebtedness basket covering the advance.
payload.if_resolved: If consent is given, compare the offers on cash capacity: the $100k/6m ($17,667/month) and $250k/6m ($44,167/month) offers carry lower monthly burdens than $250k/3m ($85,833/month), subject to the settlement-bucket unknown. If consent is refused or absent, no offer can be supported as structured; the only path would be a Knight payout, which is not feasible from the disclosed cash.

payload.fact: How much of the $2,000,000 2024 installment on the Atrium settlement loan (and of the $600,000 2024 installment on the March 27, 2024 supplier settlement) was paid between July 1 and August 13, 2024, and on what dates are the remaining 2024 installments due?
payload.why_pivotal: Sensitivity: with nothing paid since June 30, the two settlement buckets ($2.6M) plus the $200k reserve need $900k more than the ~$1.9M available cash (reported $2.0M less $100k restricted), before operating receipts. At 25% paid the gap is $250k; at 50% or more there is no gap. The paid share decides whether cash can also carry the advance's monthly installments.
payload.acceptable_evidence: Settlement payment schedules from the confidential agreements, a borrower bank or AP ledger showing payments to Atrium/HVL and the supplier since July 1, 2024, or a lender-verified statement of balances as of August 2024.
payload.if_resolved: If most of the 2024 buckets remain unpaid and fall due before the advance matures, the settlements alone use up disclosed cash: only a smaller advance ($100k/6m) or none fits within the reserve, and repayment depends on operating receipts. If they are largely paid or scheduled after the advance term, the requested $250k/6m structure is not blocked by the settlement outflows (Knight consent is still required).
